prompt_constraints_to_add: Specify the intended framing, focal subject, crop, and negative space.
hints.lighting_adjustment: Keep lighting secondary to readability; avoid shadows that obscure the subject hierarchy.
hints.composition_adjustment: Define subject placement, crop boundary, visual balance, and the intended viewer path.
hints.material_adjustment: Mention materials only when they support the composition and do not create visual clutter.
hints.rationale: Composition failures should become explicit framing and hierarchy constraints before any future run.

prompt_constraints_to_add: Specify controlled, coherent lighting with readable subject detail.
hints.lighting_adjustment: Name the light direction, softness, contrast level, and shadow tolerance.
hints.composition_adjustment: Keep framing stable while lighting is corrected so composition does not drift.
hints.material_adjustment: Describe how the light should reveal material texture without overexposing highlights.
hints.rationale: Lighting failures should become explicit illumination constraints rather than another broad style prompt.

prompt_constraints_to_add: Name the material, finish, texture, and physical realism expectation.
hints.lighting_adjustment: Use lighting that reveals believable texture and avoids plastic-looking glare.
hints.composition_adjustment: Move material-critical surfaces into clear view without crowding the frame.
hints.material_adjustment: Lock surface texture, finish, age, reflectivity, and physical plausibility.
hints.rationale: Material failures need concrete surface constraints before any future prompt can improve realism.

prompt_constraints_to_add: Lock key product or subject attributes and forbid substitutions.
hints.lighting_adjustment: Light key product details clearly without washing out shape or markings.
hints.composition_adjustment: Frame the product so identity-critical details remain visible and undistorted.
hints.material_adjustment: Preserve product-specific materials and avoid invented substitutions.
hints.rationale: Product fidelity failures must become identity locks and substitution bans.

prompt_constraints_to_add: State the target use, polish level, and production context.
hints.lighting_adjustment: Use commercially readable lighting that supports the intended placement or campaign mood.
hints.composition_adjustment: Align framing with the intended use case, such as product page, editorial crop, or review card.
hints.material_adjustment: Keep material treatment consistent with the target commercial quality level.
hints.rationale: Commercial fitness failures should become use-case and polish constraints.

prompt_constraints_to_add: Require clean edges, plausible geometry, and no text-like noise.
hints.lighting_adjustment: Avoid lighting patterns that hide distorted edges or synthetic residue.
hints.composition_adjustment: Simplify the frame so artifacts are easier to detect and less likely to accumulate.
hints.material_adjustment: Reduce ambiguous textures that can become melted, noisy, or invented surfaces.
hints.rationale: AI artifact failures should reduce ambiguity and constrain geometry before any future run.

prompt_constraints_to_add: Do not generate; repair metadata binding before any prompt correction.
hints.lighting_adjustment: No lighting adjustment is valid until registry, receipt, attempt, and review records agree.
hints.composition_adjustment: No composition adjustment is valid until source metadata is reconciled.
hints.material_adjustment: No material adjustment is valid until provenance is repaired.
hints.rationale: Provenance mismatch blocks prompt correction because the system cannot prove which asset is being corrected.
